text:
alex: heads-up — started seeing a weird 5xx spike from inference-proxy in us-west around 11:12 UTC. Kibana shows a lot of entries with correlation_id present but trace_id missing. anyone touching ingestion or log rotation?

sam: saw the alert. are these coming only from dedicated clusters or mixed?

alex: mostly gw-pool-2 (dedicated) but a handful from hosted fallbacks. sample line (redacted):

```
2026-02-18T11:12:34Z level=error msg=\"request failed\" correlation_id=cid-5f2a request_id=req-84 status=502 trace_id=
```

sam: hmm empty trace_id. can you paste the full kibana query you used?

alex: used this in Kibana Discover: `service:inference-proxy AND @timestamp:[now-1h TO now] AND status:[500 TO 599]` then inspected message field. Also ran a Loki grep: `|= \"correlation_id=\" |= \"trace_id=\"` and saw many where trace_id either missing or set to `-`.

priya: we rolled vector 0.16 to all ingest agents in us-west 48h ago to fix memory spikes. There was a config tweak to `remove_fields` on the pipeline to drop empty fields — possible it strips the `trace_id` key if value is empty string. we intentionally collapsed empty keys to save index size.

morgan: additionally we had an index template change for `logs-*` two days ago that adjusted `trace_id` mapping from `keyword` to `text` to enable full-text search; that could affect downstream parsers that expect `trace_id` as a keyword.

sam: ok pair of leads: (1) ingest agent transform dropping empty field; (2) mapping change causing parsing mismatch. priya can you confirm the exact transform?

priya: config snippet in vector.toml (deployed):

```toml
[transforms.drop_empty]
  type = \"remove_fields\"
  fields = [\"trace_id\"]
  condition = \"is_empty(field('trace_id'))\"
```

priya: so if trace_id is empty string it gets removed from the event entirely. that makes the log message look like `trace_id=` -> no key in the JSON doc when it lands in ES/Loki.

theo: that explains missing key. but why are trace_ids empty for so many requests? is the app not generating them or are our SDKs dropping them?

alex: app logs show trace_id populated earlier in the request path for some traces, but our sidecar that does tracing injection timed out on certain requests (seen in pod logs around the same time) and emitted `trace_id=\"\"` rather than nothing. looks like a race between tracing sidecar and proxy.

morgan: so timeline: sidecar emitted empty trace_id -> vector transform removed field -> indexing into ES/Loki has no trace_id key. when people search by trace_id in Kibana they miss these entries.

sam: action plan: 1) priya revert remove_empty on vector for now (set to only drop null, not empty string), 2) infra to patch sidecar so it doesn't emit empty string, 3) create temporary Kibana saved search that searches message text for `trace_id=` patterns until historical rebuild.

priya: starting rollback now. will push config that checks `is_null` not `is_empty`. deploying to us-west agent pool.

deploy-bot: deploy started for vector/us-west-config@2026-02-18T11:34Z by priya

sam: while priya rolls back, can someone craft a Loki query to find traces that lost trace_id but still have correlation_id so we can correlate to traces in Zipkin? something like:

```
{app=\"inference-proxy\", region=\"us-west\"} |= \"correlation_id=\" |~ \"trace_id=($|\\s)\" | json
```

(the regex part is rough)

theo: i'll try a pragmatic approach: search for `correlation_id=` and then `| regexp "trace_id= *$"` to match trailing empty. also we should add a Prometheus counter in the proxy `inference_proxy_trace_missing_total{region="us-west"}` and alert if ratio > 1% of requests.

alex: +1 on metric. i'll open a quick PagerDuty ticket if rollback doesn't reduce missing-trace ratio within 10m.

morgan: FYI, we also need to reindex the last 6 hours to recover missing trace_id fields if we want full historical joins. that's heavy (S3 snapshot -> reindex) so let's hold until we confirm scope.

priya: rollback complete, vector/us-west-config@2026-02-18T11:40Z — remove_empty disabled.

deploy-bot: deploy succeeded for vector/us-west-config@2026-02-18T11:40Z

priya: can you all re-run the Kibana and Loki queries in 3-5m? ingestion lag is ~2m.

sam: re-ran a quick check at 11:44, trace_id presence jumped from 78% to 99.2% in the 15m window. nice.

theo: opened GH issue / PR to stop emitting empty trace_id from sidecar and added a unit test. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/tracing/pull/418

alex: created JIRA SRE-2249 to track followups: reindex decision, add metric + alert, update index template back to keyword for trace_id, and sidecar fix. assigning to priya + theo.

morgan: leaving a note to update SLO dashboard: counts of requests without trace_id should be surfaced under the logs tab so support can pivot — will add panel.

alex: thanks all. monitoring for regressions; will PD if we see >5% missing again. :thumbsup:
